button.label: Add/Edit Citation
button.supertip: Insert a citation from your Pith library. With the cursor in a Pith citation: change its references and page numbers, or remove it.

button.label: Bibliography
button.supertip: Insert the bibliography below the current paragraph.

button.label: Refresh
button.supertip: Update all Pith citations and the bibliography in this document.

dynamicMenu.label: Style
dynamicMenu.supertip: Choose the citation style of this document. Styles imported in Pith are listed too.

button.label: Convert Zotero
button.supertip: Turn the Zotero citations and bibliography in this document into Pith citations.

button.label: Open Pith
button.supertip: Bring the Pith window to the front.
